authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1

implementation.profile: R24 TABLESTYLE title/header/data styles retain their exact identity, alignment and other field gates; each content text height now admits any finite nonnegative value.

checks: Typed readback preserves every per-style text height and the raw group-144 sequence is compared against the source style order.
Negative and infinite text heights are refused while preserving the destination sentinel.
The corrected profile succeeds on the same adapter after refusal.
control.fixture_policy: No DWG/DXF fixture is committed; output is temporary and removed.

limits: This is generated field-transport and typed-readback evidence only.
Native font/layout/rendering semantics, physical DWG producer profiles, and whole-source conversion remain open.
Other R24 TABLESTYLE schema fields retain their existing gates.
